main_results: G implies the mathematical positivity gate A with a 5% threshold margin
G implies the master Schur pivot floor with L2 = 4.0e5/5.7e5/7.4e5
G is contained in the original backend accept set B

unguarded_original_backend.reason: the proof gives A\B subset A\G and B superset G; the numeric q_C bound is valid for A\G, hence for A\B.  The original backend may accept roots outside G; they remain in A and are counted in the same TV bound.  Only the non-retryable failure mode prevents a 64th-power abort statement.

null_ledger: unguarded beta_bad mass: null (guarded data-processing theorem does not need it)

uniform or average finite-chain/issuance TV over all B accepted roots: null (B\\G per-root error is not bounded; only the root-law distance to mu(.|A) is bounded by q_C/(1-q_A), and the guarded service accepts only G)
literal-density first issuance: null (gadget digit-normalizer gate fails)
exact RingSchur acceptance certifier: failed at the 16384-bit rational cap on a Table 4 root; not used
exact author sampler / C program correspondence: null
native strong, structural hardness, NIST category: null
fault history: null (no fault probability model)
